title: Network authorization received
description:
This event represents an authorization action. All actions (authorize, decline, confirm, cancel, partially cancel, and so on) generate this event. The Pismo platform issues this event after it processes the message from the card network and determines a decision about which action to take. This event is for Full balance and Zero balance issuers. Zero balance issuers receive this authorization event and they get the raw message as part of what is sent when the platform calls the issuer's webhook. For more information, refer to the Authorization events guide. Also refer to Linking events in an authorization.

Note: The settlement or reconciliation date (clearing - Base II) is something you need to calculate. You should consider conciliation_information.processing_julian_date which is the acquirer-assigned settlement date plus the number of days related to the product. For example, for Visa, the calculation is D+1 (debit) or D+27 (credit).

Also note that this does not apply to balance inquiry authorizations or transactions. Balance inquiries do not generate a Network authorization event.

authorization_category.title: Event category
authorization_category.description: Authorization category field indicates what type of action on an authorization generated that event. In base 1, the category is `AUTHORIZATION`, in base 2, it is `CONFIRMATION`. Each message processed by the Pismo platform, whether from the online flow or clearing, emits a Network authorization received event with the corresponding category. `AUTHORIZATION` is for online approvals. `CONFIRMATION` is for clearing confirmations.

authorization_type.title: Authorization type
authorization_type.description: Type of authorization. Currently, this event is only issued for authorizations coming from the Card Network, so this field is a constant value.

account_id.title: Account ID
account_id.description: Pismo account ID. This information is fetched using the Card used in the authorization. If no card is found, this information will not be present in the DECLINED event.

acquirer_bin.title: Acquirer Identifier
acquirer_bin.description: Identifies the acquiring institution (for example, merchant bank) or its agent. This field represents the value received in field 32 of the Card Network Specification.

advice_detail_code.title: Advice detail code
advice_detail_code.description: Identifies the detail why the card network issued this advice. This field is only used for Mastercard requests and it represents the value received in the DE60 subfield 2 of the specification, if it is present in the card network message.

advice_reason_code.title: Advice reason code
advice_reason_code.description: Why the card network issued this advice. For messages other than advices, this field is null. In Mastercard requests this field represents the value received in the DE60 subfield 1 of the specification. For Visa requests, this field represents the value received in the F63.4 of the specification.

airport_tax.title: Airport tax amount
airport_tax.description: This field is populated only in the `CONFIRMATION` event. The actual airport tax value (in the cardholder's currency) appears exclusively when `authorization_category` is `CONFIRMATION`. In all other categories, including `AIRPORT_TAX` and `AUTHORIZATION`, this field is null.

anti_fraud_execution_time.title: Anti-fraud API response time
anti_fraud_execution_time.description: Time in milliseconds between the anti-fraud API call and its response

arqc_present.title: ARQC present flag
arqc_present.description: Authorization Request Cryptogram. Indicates whether the authorization request was performed and the cryptogram information (field 55 of the Card Network specification) was present in the message.

atc.title: Application transaction counter
atc.description: The ATC (application transaction counter) is a counter, maintained by the chip card application (incremented by the chip), that provides a sequential reference to each transaction.  This field is the ATC value for this card  on this authorization. Only authorization requests with cryptogram information contain this counter.

authorization_code.title: Authorization request authorization code
authorization_code.description: An alphanumeric 6-digit code generated for an authorization request that can be used to relate this event to other events associated with the same authorization. For more information, see the Linking authorization events guide.

authorization_date_hour.title: Authorization UTC-3 date/time
authorization_date_hour.description: Datetime Pismo platform received the authorization (Base 1) or, for Base 2, the clearing datetime, in Brazil (GMT-3).

authorization_id.title: Authorization unique ID
authorization_id.description: Authorization internal ID. This ID is unique and must be the same in all events related to the same authorization. It can be used to relate the current event with other events of the same authorization. For more information, see the Linking authorization events guide.

authorization_response_code.title: Authorization response code
authorization_response_code.description: Response code the authorization platform assigns to the authorization request. Indicates whether it was declined or not.

authorization_status.title: Authorization status
authorization_status.description: Authorization internal status code. Current authorization status for the action which issued this event. (1- Pending, 2- Confirmed, 3- Declined, 4- Cancelled, 5- Dropped).

authorization_url.title: Authorization URL
authorization_url.description: Authorization API URL configured per program. Present when core-banking operations are made in our client's side.

caller.title: Card network
caller.description: Card network generating the authorization request.

cancelled_by_elapsed_time.title: Cancelled by elapsed time flag
cancelled_by_elapsed_time.description: Was an authorization cancelled due to elapsed time without a confirmation message flag.

card_acceptor_id.title: Card acceptor ID
card_acceptor_id.description: Identifies the card acceptor defining the transaction point in both local and interchange environments. This field represents the value received in field 42 of the Card Network Specification.

card_id.title: Card ID
card_id.description: Pismo card ID. If no card is found, based on the PAN received, this information will not be present in the DECLINED event.

cardholder_currency_code.title: Currency Code of the Cardholder
cardholder_currency_code.description: Cardholder ISO4217 currency code for currency used to bill the account. The final authorization amount is calculated in this currency.

cardholder_currency_code_literal.title: Currency Code of the Cardholder as Literal
cardholder_currency_code_literal.description: Field represent Cardholder ISO4217 currency code for currency used to bill the account as literal.

cid.title: Authorizaton correlation ID
cid.description: Authorization correlation ID . Along with the `authorization_id`, you can use this field to relate it to other events associated with this authorization. For more information, see the Linking authorization events guide.

conciliation_information.title: Conciliation information
conciliation_information.description: Information regarding the conciliation message being processed for this authorization.

acquirer_reference_number.title: Acquirer reference number
acquirer_reference_number.description: Acquirer-supplied data in an acquirer-originated message. An issuer may be required to return this data in a subsequent message to the acquirer.

installment_number.title: Installment current number
installment_number.description: Indicates the installment number in the concilation message being processed.

interchange_fee_amount.title: Interchange fee amount
interchange_fee_amount.description: Interchange fee amount received in the conciliation message. Every time a retailer processes a credit card or debit card payment, the merchant pays an interchange fee. This fee, often called a 'swipe fee,' is designed to cover the costs associated with accepting, processing and authorizing card transactions.

interchange_fee_indicator.title: Credit or debit fee indicator
interchange_fee_indicator.description: Indicates if the interchange fee amount is a debit or a credit.

message_number.title: Conciliation message number
message_number.description: Card network assigned number in the conciliation file for this conciliation message.

processing_julian_date.title: Assigned Julian date
processing_julian_date.description: Julian processing date the acquirer assigns for this settlement. This field has the format YDDD (Julian format. Ex: 4242, where 4 is the last digit of the year 2024 and 242 is the Julian day corresponding to today, 08/29).

file_path.title: Conciliation file path
file_path.description: Path to the conciliation file containing this message.

is_first_confirmation.title: First confirmation flag
is_first_confirmation.description: Indicates whether this is the first confirmation message for this authorization.

conciliation_type.title: Program conciliation type
conciliation_type.description: Type of conciliation used for this authorization. Single message for authorizations which create transactions from Base I messages, Dual message for authorizations which create transactions from Base II messages.

contract_amount.title: Authorization contract amount
contract_amount.description: Calculated authorization amount, including taxes or fees, in the cardholder's currency. For Declined transactions this field may be null, since no calculation was performed.

created_from_authorization_not_found.title: Created from authorization not found flag
created_from_authorization_not_found.description: Indicates whether an authorization was created in the clearing flow for scenarios where we didn't find a corresponding Base1 Authorization.

custom_response_code.title: Internal denial Code
custom_response_code.description: Internal custom code generated in authorization flow for declined requests. Indicates the reason the request was declined. For more information, see the Validation codes for authorization events guide

customer_id.title: Customer ID
customer_id.description: ID of customer holding card used in this authorization. If no card is found, this information will be null in the DECLINED event.

cvv_present.title: CVV present flag
cvv_present.description: Indicates whether the authorization request was performed and the card's CVV2 (card verification value) was present.

event_date_hour.title: Received message date/time
event_date_hour.description: Datetime purchase took place at the merchant. Timezone may vary based on purchase location. If these values are present, they are used without validations and since the network only sends the day and month, the current year is assumed. If they are not present, the current time of the authorization (base 1) is used (UTC-3). The values could potentially be incorrect, since this is what the acquirer entered without alteration. This field is present for both authorization (base 1) and clearing (base 2).

event_date_hour_utc.title: DateTime in UTC
event_date_hour_utc.description: Datetime when Pismo platform received the authorization (base 1), or, for Base 2, the clearing datetime, in UTC-0.

file_date.title: File processing date
file_date.description: Date when issuer processed the Base II file.

incoming_authorization_code.title: Authorization code
incoming_authorization_code.description: Authorization code from the card network in field 38 of the message request. If the request was approved in the Stand-In flow, this field indicates the authorization code assigned to this message.

incoming_response_code.title: Network response code
incoming_response_code.description: Any response code from the Card Network in  field 39 of the message request. It indicates whether the request was approved in the Stand-In flow.

installment_amount.title: Calculated authorization installment amount
installment_amount.description: Calculated amount of each installment in the authorization in the cardholder's currency. For authorizations without installments, this field will be the same as the total authorization amount. For Declined transactions this field may be null, since no calculation was performed.

installments_information.title: Installment information
installments_information.description: Details about all installments and their amounts.

installment_amount.title: Total installment amount
installment_amount.description: Calculated total amount for all installments.

number.title: Installment number
number.description: Identifies which installment this object is about.

postings.title: Installment fees and taxes.
postings.description: Taxes and fees calculated for this installment.

amortization.title: Installment amortization amount
amortization.description: Calculated amortization amount for this installment when calculating a purchase with installments and interest.

daily_iof_amount.title: Daily IOF (Brazilian tax) amount
daily_iof_amount.description: Calculated installment's daily IOF (Brazilian tax) amount in the cardholder's currency.

fixed_iof_amount.title: Fixed IOF (Brazilian tax) amount
fixed_iof_amount.description: Calculated installment's daily fixed IOF (Brazilian tax) in the cardholder's currency. The calculated fixed amount is always set to the first installment.

interest_amount.title: Interest amount
interest_amount.description: Calculated installment interest in the cardholder's currency.

iof_amount.title: IOF (Brazilian tax) amount
iof_amount.description: Calculated installment IOF (Brazilian tax) in the cardholder's currency. This field sums the installment's daily and fixed IOF amount

labels.title: Authorization Labels
labels.description: List with all labels related to this authorization. Each label identifies an authorization characteristic. DCC = Dynamic currency conversion, ATC = Application transaction counter

ledger_update_id.title: Ledger update ID
ledger_update_id.description: ID from Ledger API indicating the account limit impact. This field may be null since some authorizations don't have any financial impact.

local_amount.title: Authorization local amount
local_amount.description: Amount in local currency where the authorization was requested. The value received in field 4 of the Card Network Specification.

local_currency_code.title: Local amount currency code
local_currency_code.description: Currency code of the place where the authorization was requested. The value received in field 49 of the Card Network Specification.

local_currency_code_literal.title: Local amount currency code as literal
local_currency_code_literal.description: Currency code of the place where the authorization was requested as literal.

merchant_category_id.title: Merchant category code
merchant_category_id.description: Merchant category code based on the merchant's type of business or service. This field represents the value received in field 18 of the Card Network Specification.

merchant_city.title: Card acceptor (merchant) city
merchant_city.description: Merchant's city. This field represents the value received in field 43, subfield 2, of the Card Network Specification.

merchant_denial_code.title: Merchant denial code
merchant_denial_code.description: Merchant denial code communicates the reason for declining authorizations and the course of action that merchants can take.

merchant_name.title: Card acceptor (merchant) name
merchant_name.description: Merchant's 'doing business as' name. This field represents the value received in field 43, subfield 1, of the Card Network Specification.

merchant_state_or_country.title: Card acceptor (merchant) country/state
merchant_state_or_country.description: Merchant's country/state. This field represents the value received in field 43, subfield 3, of the Card Network Specification.

merchant_zip_code.title: Card acceptor (merchant) postal code
merchant_zip_code.description: Postal code of merchant where the transaction took place.

merchant_terminal.title: Merchant terminal
merchant_terminal.description: Code used to identify the merchant terminal.

metadata.title: Anti-fraud metadata
metadata.description: Any valid JSON sent in the response from the anti-fraud request. This information is saved and sent in this event as it was received by the platform, without any further processing.

mti.title: Message type indicator
mti.description: Message type indicator - Card Network request type. Can be used to identify whether the request is an Advice (Standin flow) or not. For more information, see MTI

nsu.title: Message initiator ID
nsu.description: Message initiator assigned ID that uniquely identifies a transaction. This field contains the value received in the authorization message in field 11 of the Card Network Specification.

number_of_installments.title: Authorization number of installments
number_of_installments.description: In purchases with installments, this field represents the number of installments for which the authorization was requested. For any operation other than purchase with installments, this value should be 1.

org_operation_id.title: Operation unique ID
org_operation_id.description: Internal identifier of the operation performed on this authorization. This information is related to the Processing Code (field 3 in the Card Network Specification) of the authorization. If the Operation is not allowed for that program or the Processing Code is not mapped, this field will not be present in the DECLINED event.

origin.title: Transaction origin
origin.description: Identifies where one transaction was issued, if it is from STRIKER('Rebatedor') or migrated from historical data

original_authorization_date_hour.title: Original authorization UTC-3 date/time
original_authorization_date_hour.description: UTC-3 sate and time of the original authorization. Indicates the time when the platform received the request that creates the authorization from the Network. No field in the Card Network message is considered. If this is the authorization request, the value of this field will be the same as the `authorization_date_hour`. For other requests such as cancellation and confirmation, this field's value will be the date when the authorization was first requested.

original_event_date_hour_utc.title: Original authorization UTC-0 date/timeDate
original_event_date_hour_utc.description: UTC-0 date and time of the original authorization. Indicates when the platform received the request that creates the authorization from the network. No field in the Card Network message is considered. If this is the authorization request, the value of this field will be the same as the `event_date_hour_utc`. For other requests such as cancellation and confirmation, the value of this field will be the date when the authorization was first requested.

pan.title: Primary account number hash
pan.description: Hashed PAN (Primary Account Number). This hash is generated from the PAN and is unique inside the platform. You can use it to identify a card together with the `card_id` field.

password_present.title: Password present flag
password_present.description: Indicates whether the authorization request was performed and the card's password is present.

entry_mode.title: Authorization entry mode
entry_mode.description: The method used for PAN entry to initiate a transaction and the PIN entry capabilities. This field represents the value received in field 22 of the Card Network Specification.

cash_back_amount.title: Cash back amount
cash_back_amount.description: In purchase with cash back or POS withdrawal, this is the amount related to the withdrawal/cash back. The principal amount is the sum of this amount with the purchase amount.

fee_amount.title: Fee amount
fee_amount.description: Calculated fee for this authorization in the cardholder's currency.

interest_amount.title: Interest rate
interest_amount.description: Calculated amount of interest rate for this authorization in the cardholder's currency.

iof_amount.title: IOF amount
iof_amount.description: Calculated amount of IOF (Brazilian tax) for this authorization in the cardholder's currency.

purchase_amount.title: Purchase amount
purchase_amount.description: In a purchase with cash back or POS withdrawal, this is the amount related to the purchase itself. The principal amount is the sum of this amount with the cash back amount.

principal_amount.title: Principal authorization amount
principal_amount.description: Calculated amount of the authorization without taxes or fees in the cardholder's currency. For Declined transactions this field may be null, since no calculation was performed.

processing_code.title: Processing code
processing_code.description: Type of request being processed, like purchase, withdrawal, purchase with installments, credit return and so on. See Processing codes and transaction types for more information

program_id.title: Program ID
program_id.description: Internal identifier of the card's program used for this authorization. If no card is found, this information will not be present in the DECLINED event.

rates.description: Contains the rates used to calculate the amounts of this authorization.

cardholder_conversion_rate.title: Cardholder conversion rate
cardholder_conversion_rate.description: Calculated conversion rate from local currency into cardholder currency.

settlement_conversion_rate.title: Settlement conversion rate
settlement_conversion_rate.description: Calculated conversion rate from local currency into settlement currency.

conversion_rate.title: Conversion rate
conversion_rate.description: Calculated conversion rate from settlement currency into cardholder currency.

daily_iof_rate.title: Daily IOF rate
daily_iof_rate.description: Rate of the daily IOF (Brazilian tax) used to calculate this authorization.

fixed_iof_rate.title: Fixed IOF rate
fixed_iof_rate.description: Rate of the fixed IOF (Brazilian tax) used to calculate this authorization.

interest_rate.title: Interest rate
interest_rate.description: Interest rate used to calculate this authorization.

international_iof_rate.title: International IOF rate
international_iof_rate.description: Rate of the international IOF (Brazilian tax) used to calculate this authorization.

retrieval_reference_number.title: Retrieval reference number
retrieval_reference_number.description: The value received in the authorization message in field 37 of the Card Network Specification.

settlement_amount.title: Settlement amount
settlement_amount.description: Amount of funds to be transferred between the acquirer and the issuer equal to the transaction amount in the settlement currency. This field represents the amount received in field 5 of the Card Network Specification.

settlement_currency_code.title: Settlement amount currency code
settlement_currency_code.description: Currency code of the settlement amount received in the authorization message - the value received in field 50 of the Card Network Specification.

settlement_currency_code_literal.title: Settlement amount currency code as literal
settlement_currency_code_literal.description: Currency code of the settlement amount received in the authorization message as literal.

soft_descriptor.title: Merchant descriptor
soft_descriptor.description: The merchant's name, city, and country concatenated.

tid.title: Transaction ID
tid.description: Transaction ID. Card network generated ID. It will be null in cases where the card network doesn't send this value. This field represents the value received in Field 62 subfield 2 for Visa requests and the DE63, subfield 2 for Mastercard requests.

token_information.title: Token information
token_information.description: Information about token used to authenticate authorization.

network_token.title: Network Token
network_token.description: Token identifier coming from the network. For Visa requests, this field represents the value received in the F123, Usage 2, Dataset ID 68 (Token Data), Tag 01. For Mastercard requests, it is DE48, SE 33 PanMappingFileInformation, SF2 Account Number.

network_requestor_id.title: Network requestor ID
network_requestor_id.description: Wallet which requested the token provisioning, as coming from the network. For Visa requests, this field represents the value received in the F123, Usage 2, Dataset ID 68 (Token Data), Tag 03. For Mastercard requests, it is DE48, SE 33 PanMappingFileInformation, SF6 Token Requestor ID.

requestor_id.title: Requestor ID
requestor_id.description: Wallet which requested the token provisioning.

track1_present.title: Track1 present flag
track1_present.description: Indicates whether the authorization request was performed and the track1 (field 45 of the Card Network specification) was present in the message.

track2_present.title: Track2 present flag
track2_present.description: Indicates whether the authorization request was performed and the track2 (field 35 of the Card Network specification) was present in the message.

transaction_status.title: Authorization purpose Identifier
transaction_status.description: The authorization request's purpose or status. For Visa request, it indicates if the authorization is a Normal Request or a Pre Authorized Request. For Mastercard requests, it represents the value of the DE61, subfield 7 that contains the same information as the Visa but can have some other purpose identifiers.

type.title: Event type
type.description: Type of event. Currently, this event is only issued for authorizations so the value is a constant.

unique_cid.title: Unique correlation ID
unique_cid.description: Unique correlation ID generated for each authorization action. In cancellation or confirmation, this CID is unique.

validation_results.title: Validation results
validation_results.description: All executed validations with details for each result.

additional_data.title: Additional data
additional_data.description: Additional information relevant to identify how the validation was performed. Every validation will have its own additional data, so please refer to the Pismo Developers Guide to identify every possibility.

description.title: Description
description.description: Detailed information about the validation result.

service_indicator.title: Service indicator
service_indicator.description: Service indicator ID, corresponding to DE48 SE71 on Mastercard or F126 S20 on Visa.

electronic_commerce_indicator.title: Electronic commerce indicator
electronic_commerce_indicator.description: Electronic commerce indicator ID, corresponding to DE48 SE42 on Mastercard or F60 S08 on Visa.

cardholder_authentication.title: Cardholder authentication
cardholder_authentication.description: Cardholder authentication method, corresponding to DE48 SE43 on Mastercard or F44 S13 on Visa.

authentication_data.title: Authetication data
authentication_data.description: Cardholder authentication method, corresponding to DE48 SE66 on Mastercard or F126 S09 on Visa.

related_accounts.title: The Related Accounts object is used during authorization in operations with shared limits.
related_accounts.description: The Related Accounts object lists all the accounts within an account hierarchy in an authorization of a shared limit among these accounts.

account_id.title: Account Id.
account_id.description: Identifier of the account returned when searching the account hierarchy.

is_centralizer.title: Is Centralizer.
is_centralizer.description: It indicates whether the account is the centralizing account within the hierarchy. The centralizing account will group the debits of the accounts within the hierarchy.

level.title: Level.
level.description: Represents the level of connection between the account returned in the object and the account used during authorization.

parent_account_id.title: Parent Account Id.
parent_account_id.description: Identifier of the parent account of the account returned in the object.

ledger_impact_accounts.title: Ledger Impact Accounts.
ledger_impact_accounts.description: Information regarding impacts in ledger domain.

ledger_update_id.title: Ledger Update Id.
ledger_update_id.description: ID from Ledger API indicating the account limit impact for each account impacted. This field may be null since some authorizations don't have any financial impact.

network_dcc_indicator.title: Network Dynamic Currency Conversion Indicator
network_dcc_indicator.description: Dynamic Currency Conversion indicator (field 126.19 of the Card Network specification) as provided by the network. The platform never recomputes this value; it is propagated exactly as received. Absent in the message defaults to false.

single_tap_indicator.title: Single Tap Indicator
single_tap_indicator.description: Single Tap indicator as provided by the network. The platform never recomputes this value; it is propagated exactly as received. Absent in the message defaults to false.
